model.title: CRUISE Act
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Tom Barrett (R-MI)

summary.text: The bill would streamline the Department of Veterans Affairs' process for reimbursing automobile dealers when disabled veterans purchase vehicles through the VA's auto assistance program, aiming to make payments faster and more efficient.
